searchText: MSRP $454,338. New 2026 Newmar Northern Star 3418 for sale at Motor Home Specialist Features Four Slide Outs Theater Seats Central Vacuum Drop Down Loft Splendide Washer/Dryer Wifi Ranger Whirlpool 19.7, 2 Extra Batt. Exterior TV More About This RV Pack your bags for an extended vacation in this four slide out coach! Once you've parked for the day, you can make lunch in the full kitchen that includes a 30' stainless steel convection microwave with a three burner cooktop and an air fryer feature. There is a 10 cu. ft. Norcold refrigerator and pantry to store your food, plus a booth dinette where you can dine together. A Jackknife sofa provides more seating space, or you may just find yourselves outdoors under the Carefree Travel'r awning. The mid-coach full bath will be easily accessible for everyone to use, and the rear private bedroom provides you with your own space at night. Here, you'll enjoy a queen bed slide out with overhead storage, a dresser with a Samsung LED TV, plus a wardrobe with sliding mirror doors. There is even a second wardrobe with an optional Splendide two-piece stacked washer and dryer if you plan to go full-time! Step right up to the diesel pusher lifestyle with Newmar's most affordable Class A diesel coach, the Northern Star! You will be met with a luxurious interior that includes maple cabinet doors, polished solid-surface countertops, Villa Comfort Fit furniture, and MCD window shades to name a few comforts. The Full-Paint Masterpiece Finish is ultra sleek, and the diamond shield protection on the front cap will help against debris, bugs, and more. The driver is sure to appreciate the V-Ride drive axle suspension, along with the anti-lock braking system and Mobileye lane tracking and lane departure warning system for added safety. Each model also includes a Samsung LED TV in the living room and bedroom, a 10' Sony dash radio, a Bose soundbar sound system, and more entertainment features to ensure you'll never go bored on rainy days!
